description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Line_Array', which manages a sequential array of line styles for graph rendering, allowing addition and retrieval of line styles and colors, and handling style sequencing.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Line_Array
classes.description: A class that manages a sequential array of line styles for graph rendering, supporting addition, color assignment, and style retrieval.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a line style object to the array, optionally with an ID.

methods.name: addColor
methods.description: Adds a color to the line style array, optionally with an ID.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the next line style in sequence, handling object styles and fallback to parent method.
